# Template variables in attributes must be quoted.
# ruleid: unquoted-attribute-var
<div class={{ userClass }}>hi</div>
# ruleid: unquoted-attribute-var
<span id={{ itemId }}>x</span>
# ok: unquoted-attribute-var
<div class="{{ userClass }}">hi</div>
# ok: unquoted-attribute-var
<div class='{{ userClass }}'>hi</div>
